sources.title: GitHub - basimrdj/nimora: A cinematic browser and terminal explorer for ...
sources.snippet: Nimora is a focused, local-first chat explorer for NVIDIA-hosted inference models. Move through the same 118-model catalog in a crafted browser workspace or an animated keyboard-first terminal, then stream responses with model-aware controls for reasoning, images, tools, and structured JSON.

sources.title: Nimora - AI SEO, Product Media & Analytics - WordPress.org
sources.snippet: The Nimora WordPress plugin is free to install. A Nimora account is required to connect your site to the Nimora service. Nimora may offer Free, Pro, Business, and Rockstar service plans for different limits and workflows such as AI SEO, analytics, image alt text, content generation, product media, and advanced ecommerce automation.
